readme:
# Website Contact Extractor

Extract contact information from any website — emails, phone numbers, social media links, and company address — in a single run. Give it a list of URLs and get back one consolidated contact record per site. No API keys needed.

## How It Works

For each URL you provide, the scraper:

1. Visits the homepage and captures the page title and meta description
2. Parses schema.org JSON-LD structured data to extract the company address
3. Discovers internal links — contact, about, impressum, team, and privacy pages are always crawled first
4. Extracts email addresses from page text and `mailto:` links
5. Extracts phone numbers from `tel:` links and international-format (+XX) text
6. Finds social media profile links (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Xing)
7. Returns one record per website with all contact details consolidated

Challenge pages (bot-protection walls) are skipped automatically so the run keeps going.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=nanoscrape/website-contact-extractor
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `website-contact-extractor` to extract the contact email, phone number, and LinkedIn page for acme-corp.com."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Input Example

```json
{
  "urls": [
    "acme-corp.com",
    "https://www.another-company.de",
    "https://startup.io/contact"
  ],
  "maxPagesPerUrl": 15
}
```

Bare domains (`acme-corp.com`) and full URLs are both accepted.

## Output Example

```json
[
  {
    "url": "https://acme-corp.com",
    "domain": "acme-corp.com",
    "title": "Acme Corp — Business Solutions",
    "description": "We help businesses automate their operations worldwide.",
    "emails": ["info@acme-corp.com", "sales@acme-corp.com"],
    "phones": ["+1 555 123 4567"],
    "address": "123 Main St, San Francisco, CA 94105, US",
    "social_links": {
      "linkedin": "https://linkedin.com/company/acme-corp",
      "twitter": "https://twitter.com/acmecorp",
      "facebook": "https://facebook.com/acmecorp"
    },
    "pages_crawled": 9,
    "scraped_at": "2026-05-06T10:00:00Z"
  }
]
```

## Pricing

You pay per website processed — one charge per contact record regardless of how many emails or phone numbers were found.

| Event | Price | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| Actor start | $0.15 | Covers container startup |
| Contact result | $0.001 | Per website contact record produced |

**Example costs:**

| Websites | Cost |
|----------|------|
| 1 website | $0.151 |
| 100 websites | $0.25 |
| 1,000 websites | $1.15 |
| 10,000 websites | $10.15 |

No monthly fees. No minimum spend.

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `urls` | string[] | required | Website URLs or bare domains to scrape |
| `maxPagesPerUrl` | integer | 15 | Max pages to crawl per site (1–50) |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | Apify proxy | Proxy settings |

## Output Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `url` | string | Input URL that was scraped |
| `domain` | string | Normalized domain name |
| `title` | string | Page title from the homepage |
| `description` | string | Meta description from the homepage |
| `emails` | string[] | All unique email addresses found (lowercase) |
| `phones` | string[] | Phone numbers from tel: links and international-format text |
| `address` | string | Company address from schema.org JSON-LD structured data |
| `social_links` | object | Social profiles found (linkedin, twitter, facebook, instagram, youtube, xing) |
| `pages_crawled` | integer | Number of pages visited |
| `scraped_at` | string | ISO timestamp of when the record was produced |

## Tips

- **Contact and impressum pages are checked first** — the scraper prioritizes `/contact`, `/kontakt`, `/impressum`, `/about`, `/team`, and similar paths
- **15 pages covers most SMB and mid-market sites** — most businesses expose all contact info within the first 15 pages
- **Increase to 30–50 pages** for large corporate sites or to find role-specific emails (hr@, press@)
- **One record per website** — all emails, phones, and social links from a site are consolidated into a single row, making it easy to use in spreadsheets or CRMs
- **Address from structured data** — address is only populated when the site includes schema.org JSON-LD markup (common on SMB and local business sites)

inputSchema.title: Website Contact Extractor Input
inputSchema.description: Configure the websites to crawl for contact details. Provide either `urls` (simple URL list) or `companies` (URLs with company_id passthrough for join-back).

urls.title: URLs or Domains
urls.description: List of website URLs or domains to extract contact details from. Bare domains (example.com) and full URLs (https://www.example.com) are both accepted.

companies.title: Companies (with company_id passthrough)
companies.description: Alternative to `urls`. Each entry carries a company_id that is echoed on the output row, enabling downstream join-back to your data.

company_id.title: Company ID
company_id.description: Your internal identifier — echoed on the output row so you can join enrichment results back to your source data.

website_url.title: Website URL
website_url.description: The company's website URL to crawl.

maxPagesPerUrl.title: Max Pages Per URL
maxPagesPerUrl.description: Maximum pages to crawl per website. Contact, about, impressum, and team pages are always prioritized. Higher values find more details but take longer.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Apify proxy works for most sites.
